slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>Myles Garrett missed his second consecutive practice with swelling in his knee on Tuesday, Aug. 11, Los Angeles Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters. Garrett was present for the Rams' joint practice with the Dallas Cowboys but stood and watched on the sideline with a sleeve on his left leg.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) though he maintained that there's no cause for concern and that Garrett told him he was at "85% percent." McVay also told reporters he wasn't sure which knee is bothering Garrett. "I don't know what 100 percent is going to look like, but it must be pretty good if that's 85 percent," McVay said. ". . . We're getting to learn him.

slides.title: Cowboys countdown to kickoff: Top 100 iconic games – Day 33
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>DALLAS, TX - CIRCA 1978: Defensive end Ed Too Tall Jones #72 of the Dallas Cowboys in action against the Atlanta Falcons during an NFL game circa 1978 at Texas Stadium in Dallas, Texas. Jones played for the Cowboys from 1974-78 and 1980-89.
<<<INDENT>>>We are looking back at the 100 most iconic games in Dallas Cowboys history. The countdown leads us right up to the opening game of 2026. Our rankings do not depend on just one criterion.

slides.title: Drew Brees to join Saints Ring of Honor during halftime ceremony against Vikings
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>“We are thrilled to welcome Drew into this distinguished group in October. His extraordinary accomplishments on the field, his leadership, and his lasting contributions to the New Orleans community make this honor well deserved. We look forward to celebrating Drew with our fans and honoring the legacy he built with the Saints and throughout the New Orleans community.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) Drew Brees signed with the New Orleans Saints in 2006 and spent 15 seasons in New Orleans before retiring in 2021. During his time with the Saints, he led the team to its first Super Bowl victory in the 2009 season, defeating the Indianapolis Colts 31–17 and earning Super Bowl MVP honors.

slides.title: Ravens CB Nate Wiggins carted off at practice with lower-body injury
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Baltimore Ravens cornerback Nate Wiggins was carted off at practice Tuesday with a lower-body injury to his left leg or knee. ESPN's Jamison Hensley reported Wiggins could not put weight on his leg and was assisted by trainers.
<<<INDENT>>>Head coach Jesse Minter said he had no further information but expressed optimism. ESPN’s Ian Rapoport reported that Wiggins did not suffer any structural damage.

slides.title: Browns claim TE Dae'Quan Wright off waivers, put DB Damarri Mathis on IR
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Browns made a pair of roster moves on Tuesday afternoon. The NFL's daily transaction report shows that they claimed tight end Dae'Quan Wright off waivers from the Eagles. They put defensive back Damarri Mathis on injured reserve in a corresponding move.
<<<INDENT>>>Wright signed with the Eagles after going undrafted out of Ole Miss.

slides.title: 49ers All-Pro Nick Bosa dealing with tendinitis in surgically repaired right knee; Christian McCaffrey misses another practice
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>All-Pro San Francisco 49ers edge rusher Nick Bosa is dealing with tendinitis in his surgically repaired right knee and remains absent from practice at training camp. Head coach Kyle Shanahan discussed Bosa's condition with reporters on Tuesday and downplayed concern that it could linger.
<<<INDENT>>>He said the tendinitis was "normal" for Bosa coming off surgery to repair an ACL tear and described him as "week-to-week.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) "It's a pretty normal thing with ACLs. Just talking to our guys, they say it happens to about 90% of the guys we've had. It's a normal thing, so we've got to be smart here, week-to-week.

slides.title: Jets CB Qwan'tez Stiggers transported to the hospital after passing out at practice
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers was transported in an ambulance to a local hospital after losing consciousness during a joint practice with the Buccaneers. Jets coach Aaron Glenn said after practice that Stiggers was conscious and talking on the field.
<<<INDENT>>>Stiggers also received an IV before being taken by stretcher to the waiting ambulance. The Jets have not updated Stiggers' condition. Glenn said Stiggers "came to the sideline, and he just passed out.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) he was good," Glenn said, via Rich Cimini of ESPN. The incident stopped the joint practice for 10 minutes. Stiggers, 24, entered the NFL as a fifth-round pick of the Jets in 2024 after not playing college football. He played one season for the Toronto Argonauts of the CFL. Stiggers has appeared in 29 games for the Jets, seeing action on 503 special teams snaps and 297 on defense.

slides.title: Matthew Stafford doesn't think Puka Nacua's injury was "anything too major"
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Matthew Stafford is neither a trainer nor a doctor. But as a quarterback entering his 18th pro season, he has an idea of what a serious injury looks like. Head coach Sean McVay did not have a real update on why Puka Nacua left Tuesday’s joint practice with the Cowboys, and Stafford didn't know much about it either.
<<<INDENT>>>But he also did not get any indication that Nacua's injury was significant.

slides.title: Bears sign OL Wesley French
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Bears added depth to their offensive line on Tuesday by signing Wesley French to their 90-man roster. They waived safety Brandon Hill in a corresponding move.
<<<INDENT>>>French signed with the Colts as an undrafted rookie in 2022 and played in every game for Indianapolis during the 2023 season. He spent 2024 on injured reserve and was on practice squads in Dallas and Cleveland last year.

slides.title: Jets' Stiggers in hospital after collapsing in practice
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>Qwan'tez Stiggers was a fifth-round draft pick by the New York Jets in 2024. New York Jets cornerback Qwan'tez Stiggers was taken to hospital by ambulance after collapsing during a joint practice with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers. Stiggers briefly lost consciousness on the sidelines during a training drill, prompting an immediate medical response that halted practice for more than 10 minutes. Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said the 24-year-

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) The player was conscious and talking before he was carried off the field on a stretcher for further examination. "He came to the sideline after a play and he actually fell out," Glenn told reporters. "The good thing is he was conscious. He was able to talk. For the most part, he's good."
<<<INDENT>>>Several Jets players took a knee near the sidelines, while some formed a prayer circle as their teammate was receiving medical attention.

slides.title: Fernando Mendoza may play with 1st-team offensive line Thursday
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>PT kickoff. Tuesday, new Las Vegas head coach Klint Kubiak said, Mendoza, the No. 1 overall draft pick, will get “plenty of experience” in the game. He did not indicate how much Mendoza will play, but he did say he may play some with the first-team offensive line. Mendoza is listed second on the newly released depth chart, so he will likely play after Kirk Cousins and before Aidan O’Connell. Kubiak wouldn’t say how much the starters will play,
<<<INDENT>>>(cont) only saying most of them will play. Kubiak said he doesn’t know if star defensive end Maxx Crosby will play in the game he returns from knee surgery.

slides.title: Commanders sign LB Curtis Jacobs
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Commanders announced the signing of defensive tackle Byron Cowart on Tuesday morning and added linebacker Curtis Jacobs to the 90-man roster in the afternoon. The team cut two players when they signed Cowart, so no additional moves were needed.
<<<INDENT>>>Jacobs appeared in three games for the Titans last season and played 39 special teams snaps. He had four tackles in nine games for the Patriots in 2024.

slides.title: Klint Kubiak: Fernando Mendoza will get "plenty of experience" on Thursday vs. Cardinals
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>No. 1 overall pick Fernando Mendoza is officially set to make his preseason debut on Thursday night. Raiders head coach Klint Kubiak told reporters in his Tuesday press conference that Las Vegas' starters will play in this week's matchup against the Cardinals, which means Kirk Cousins is set to be the first QB on the field.
<<<INDENT>>>But Mendoza, Kubiak said, will get "plenty of experience in the game.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) "A lot of guys we need to evaluate — he’ll get plenty of reps." Kubiak did not disclose his exact plans for playing time this week, but there is a chance Mendoza will take some snaps with the first-team offensive line.

slides.title: Giants injuries: Abdul Carter (hand), Jaxson Dart (ankle) practice
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>New York Giants pass rusher Abdul Carter reacts after drawing a penalty. The New York Giants have finished their twelfth practice of their 2026 training camp, breathing a sigh of relief as they do so. Both edge defender Abdul Carter (hand) and QB Jaxson Dart (ankle) participated in today’s practice.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) They’re one day closer to taking on the Minnesota Vikings when they host them at MetLife Stadium on Saturday at 1 p.m. The Giants practiced in shells today after a tough Monday practice. Typically, “Shells” practices are less intense than fully padded practices, and this was reportedly more of a jog-through.

slides.title: Could Steelers keep 4 QBs on opening roster? Pros, cons for every likely scenario
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Could the Pittsburgh Steelers really keep four quarterbacks on the opening 53-man roster? That's how many they have on the roster now — Aaron Rodgers, Mason Rudolph, Drew Allar and Will Howard — and there's a chance all of them remain on the roster when final cutdowns happen on Aug. 30. 
<<<INDENT>>>But there's also a possible workaround the Steelers could employ if they feel keeping four is too restrictive. Rodgers is the starter.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) back together again with Mike McCarthy after years apart, and the only thing likely knocking Rodgers from the starting lineup is an injury — or maybe sustained poor play. Still, he's 42 years old, and there's the future to also think about. Rudolph, last year's backup, might be the prototypical QB2.

slides.title: Tommy DeVito finding his ‘flow state’ as Patriots QB2
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>The quarterback did not join New England until Aug. 27, when the Patriots claimed him off waivers. DeVito spent all season as a third-stringer behind starter Drake Maye and veteran backup Joshua Dobbs. While DeVito learned New England’s offense behind the scenes, his work on the practice field came in scout-team situations. Now elevated to the primary backup in Year 2, DeVito has finally gotten on-

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) field practice experience in the offense and seen tremendous growth in his game since this spring. “It’s a different world,” DeVito said. “It’s one thing to be in the classroom and be in it and learn and everything, but it’s another thing to get reps in it. Because last year, I didn’t get reps in the offense.

slides.title: Pittsburgh Pirates vs. Miami Marlins: Paul Skenes vs. Eury Pérez
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Pittsburgh Pirates are playing the Miami Marlins in the first game of a three-game series at loanDepot Park. Paul Skenes is pitching for the Pirates.

slides.title: AZ Snake Pit Reacts Survey: A farewell to Sewald
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Throughout the year we ask questions of the most plugged-in Diamondbacks fans and fans across the country. Paul Sewald was designated for assignment by the Arizona Diamondbacks yesterday, likely ending the reliever’s tenure with the team. 
<<<INDENT>>>On the broadest level, his time here was nothing special. He pitched 107 times in the regular season for Arizona, posting an underwhelming 4.95 ERA.

slides.title: Cincinnati Reds activate Nick Lodolo, select contract of Michael Toglia
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Cincinnati Reds made official the optioning of IF/OF Ivan Johnson on Monday despite it being an off-day for the club ahead of their series in Chicago against the White Sox. They then gave us a full day to speculate on just what other roster moves lay in store as lefty Nick Lodolo was also expected to make his return to the roster for the series opener. 
<<<INDENT>>>Lodolo is officially back as of Tuesday afternoon.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) half of the roster by optioning Zach McCambley back to AAA Louisville. For the position-player half of the ledger, though, the Reds selected the contract of former Colorado Rockies slugger Michael Toglia, doing so by moving Hunter Greene to the 60-day IL as the latter gets prepped for another season-ending elbow surgery.

slides.title: Yankees’ ABS challengers to watch down the stretch
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>#13 of the New York Yankees reacts after hitting a solo home run during the second inning against the St. Louis Cardinals at Yankee Stadium on August 04, 2026 in the Bronx borough of New York City.

slides.title: Ronald Acuña to DH, Mike Yastrzemski in RF as Braves face Mets
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Atlanta Braves are looking to rebound from a tough loss last night against the New York Mets as two top ten offenses since the All-Star break meet in game two at Truist Park. The Braves have scored the seventh most runs in MLB since the All-Star break, and the Mets have scored the tenth most.
<<<INDENT>>>The rankings are a bit skewed. The gap between the two teams is sixteen runs. If the Braves had sixteen more runs since the break,

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) they would only be two runs behind the MLB leader. The Mets seem to be getting it together offensively, even without Juan Soto, which means Martín Pérez and crew will need to be on their game tonight to ensure a victory against Nolan McLean. 
<<<INDENT>>>McLean is having a solid year but has shown some weakness as of late. He held the Braves to just two earned runs over six innings in early July when he faced Pérez the first time.

slides.title: Angels fire pitching coaches, including Maddux
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Minasian hired first-time manager Kurt Suzuki on a one-year deal. Maddux, Scott, and Chiti were all in their first season with the Angels in 2026, believed to be on one-year contracts as well.
<<<INDENT>>>Owner Arte Moreno reportedly did not want contracts extending past 2026 to avoid paying during a potential work stoppage. Minasian was fired six weeks ago and replaced by John Mozeliak, former St. Louis Cardinals executive.

slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Phillies are both mediocre and the National League’s biggest threat to upset the Los Angeles Dodgers in this year’s playoffs. How can both be true? The 2026 Phillies enter Tuesday night’s game in St. Louis at 64-56, a .533 winning percentage, 7.5 games behind the Braves in the NL East and tied with the Arizona Diamondbacks for the 2nd wild card.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) water mark of 11 games over .500 on July 1 (49-38), they have gone 15-18 in their last 33 games. Over that stretch they are 15th in runs scored, 18th in OPS, 19th in batting average, and 22nd in home runs.

slides.title: Weekly Pebble Report: Starting Lanes: Jake Brooks on learning to pitch in Albuquerque
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Jake Brooks was a couple of weeks from leaving for Marlins camp in Florida when his UCLA head coach, John Savage, called him. “He gave me a ring and was like, ‘Hey man, how you feeling?’” Brooks said. 
<<<INDENT>>>Brooks was confused, and Savage told him, “I think you’re getting traded to the Rockies.” Brooks had never been traded before.

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) He didn’t know how any of it was supposed to work — who calls, in what order, how long you sit with it before anyone official confirms anything. “I was shocked, obviously,” he said. “And I was like, ‘Dude, I’ve got to start calling some people. I’ve got to figure this out.

slides.title: Red Sox News & Links: Alex Cora speaks
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Boston Red Sox manager Alex Cora was present during the game against the Detroit Tigers at Fenway Park on April 19, 2026. Neither Chaim Bloom nor Craig Breslow had the chance to hire their own manager, as Alex Cora was appointed by ownership. 
<<<INDENT>>>Even after Cora was fired, Breslow has not had the opportunity to hire a manager, as Chad Tracy was already in place before his tenure with the Red Sox.

slides.title: Angels reportedly fire pitching coach Mike Maddux, two others on his staff a few months after joining team
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>Mike Maddux has experienced a lot of success as a pitching coach over his career. But even his advice couldn't save the Los Angeles Angels. The Angels reportedly fired Maddux — along with assistant pitching coach Darryl Scott and bullpen coach Dom Chiti — on Tuesday, according to ESPN's Jeff Passan. 
<<<INDENT>>>Maddux joined them in the offseason and was working on a one-year contract.

slides.title: Yankees At-Bat of the Week: George Lombard Jr. (8/8)
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>#96 of the New York Yankees played against the Atlanta Braves at Yankee Stadium on August 08, 2026, in the Bronx. The Yankees secured an improbable series win over the Braves.
<<<INDENT>>>Pitching was key, but a young shortstop also made significant contributions. George Lombard Jr. earned his first At-bat of the Week appearance. He led off the bottom of the seventh in the middle game against the Braves on Saturday.

slides.title: Amid Mets' feel-good post-deadline run, main needs for 2027 are starting to crystallize
slides.body: <<<INDENT>>>The Mets emerged from the Aug. 3 trade deadline having dealt roughly one-third of their active roster. Since then, they have looked and played like a new team, which is not a surprise since they basically are a new team. In the week-plus since trading four key members of their bullpen, two starting pitchers, and a valuable outfielder, the Mets have gone 6-1. Along the way, they have swept a road series from one playoff contender (the Guardians),

<<<INDENT>>>(cont) took a road series from a fringe contender (the Pirates) and then snagged the opening game at Truist Park from a Braves team that is leading the NL East -- clinching the season series over Atlanta in the process.

slides.title: On The Horizon: Cubs vs. Nationals series preview
slides.body:
<<<INDENT>>>The Nationals were the Cubs’ first regular season opponent this year, way back in March. The Nats took two of three at Wrigley Field. Much has changed for both teams since then. The Cubs have solidified their claim on a postseason spot and could still win a division title.
<<<INDENT>>>After playing over .500 for quite some time, the Nats had a selloff at the Trade Deadline. The Nats are a very different team from the one that played the Cubs on Opening Day.
